verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents a guided backup/restore flow (Cloud Backup toggle, iCloud backup on iOS, restore on new device) that lets users bring accounts to a new phone, but a first-hand community report describes an update that 'wiped out all data' and caused lockout from all accounts, directly contradicting the vendor's guided one-step transfer claim. Other users report no such issue, indicating inconsistent real-world reliability rather than a uniformly seamless transfer. Missing for 10: consistent independent verification that the guided transfer works reliably across devices/OS without data loss.
